module_summary: Instruction register with two 8-bit holding registers loaded from data per fetch code, split into opcode, register-address and second-operand outputs.

anchors.name: fetch
anchors.why: Fetch code selects which register (ins_p1 or ins_p2) loads the data input.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Instruction byte loaded into ins_p1 or ins_p2.

anchors.name: ins_p1
anchors.why: Holds first instruction byte from register source; feeds ins and ad1.

anchors.name: ins_p2
anchors.why: Holds second byte from RAM/ROM source; drives ad2.

anchors.name: ins
anchors.why: Opcode field, upper 3 bits of ins_p1.

anchors.name: ad1
anchors.why: Register address field, lower 5 bits of ins_p1.

anchors.name: ad2
anchors.why: Second operand byte copied from ins_p2.

groups.name: instruction_registers
groups.description: Two instruction byte registers loaded selectively by fetch code.

groups.name: field_split
groups.description: Splits stored bytes into opcode, register address and operand outputs.
